assertions.text: Response states or implies the script is idempotent / safe to re-run
assertions.evidence: The response does not mention idempotency or that re-running is safe anywhere. It only asks clarifying questions about the file and environment variables.

assertions.text: Response asks for the .md vocabulary file path before running (Step 1 gating — no file path in prompt)
assertions.evidence: The response explicitly asks 'Which one (or ones) do you want to sync?' after listing found vocabulary files, gating execution on the user's file selection.

assertions.text: Response does not warn that re-running will cause destructive changes
assertions.evidence: The response contains no warning about destructive changes; it only asks about the file choice and missing environment variables.
